checkpoints.description: [1/3] Prove the away-mission abort path with a state-driven recall

impact_assessment.why: /api/away/recall stays context although the captain launches expeditions; its recall builder sits in the rotating tour and only runs after the 6-10 tick mission has already resolved, so an active mission is never present when it is reached and the abort route has no AI proof
impact_assessment.benefits: The captain remembers the step it launched from and recalls that mission on the next step, before a transit tick can finish it, so the recall route is exercised deterministically and the abort path is no longer unreachable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/away/recall joins SIGNATURE_ROUTES keyed by mission_id and may leave CONTEXT_ACTIONS after the gate measurement (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one abort per campaign, the expedition reward is waived by design
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for the launch step, one-step delay, one-shot and signature, 180-step gate measurement, 2,000-step campaigns on seeds 1/2/42, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Hail a captain to trust 50 and form the alliance

impact_assessment.why: /api/ally/form stays context because AI captain trust starts at 10-40 and the tour hails a captain once, so the required 50 trust is never reached; the alliance bonus (+5% trade margin and fleet support) therefore has no AI proof although hailing is free and repeatable by design
impact_assessment.benefits: After Act VI the captain hails the most trusted non-ally until trust reaches 50, then forms the alliance, so both the repeated hail path and the alliance route are exercised and the ally flag persists
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/ally/form joins SIGNATURE_ROUTES keyed by captain_id and keeps a narrowed context reason for the short gate (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: trust and ally flags only, through the existing interact path
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for the hail chain, the trust gate, the ally-once rule and the signature, 180-step gate measurement, 2,000-step campaigns on seeds 1/2/42, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Sell an equipped upgrade after the campaign so the shipyard trade-in is exercised

impact_assessment.why: /api/shipyard/sell stays context with a wrong reason (a spare hull); the route actually uninstalls and trades in an equipped hardware module by slot, and the captain always installs the warp booster, so a post-campaign sale at a dock is safe and proves the route while fixing the stale contract note
impact_assessment.benefits: The shipyard trade-in direction is exercised at a real dock, the misleading context reason becomes a precise post-Act-VI timing note, and the captain keeps a fuel margin and refuses cargo or fuel-capacity removals
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/shipyard/sell joins SIGNATURE_ROUTES keyed by slot and keeps a narrowed context reason (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: the sold slot and its stat bonus are removed by the existing engine path
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for the slot choice, fuel margin, cargo refusal, dock/story gates and signature, 180-step gate measurement, 2,000-step campaigns on seeds 1/2/42, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Trim duplicate crew after the campaign so the dismiss route is exercised

impact_assessment.why: /api/crew/dismiss stays context claiming it would erase the only roster, but the message-tree policy now recruits one engineer per refugee flotilla and campaigns end with 10-16 engineers, most unassigned; dismissing the redundant tail is safe housekeeping, saves payroll, and proves the crew lifecycle direction
impact_assessment.benefits: A post-campaign roster trim keeps the two best crew of every role-specialty pair, never touches an outpost station or escort commander, and exercises /api/crew/dismiss repeatedly until the roster is clean
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/crew/dismiss joins SIGNATURE_ROUTES keyed by crew_id and keeps a narrowed context reason for the short gate (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: only the redundant crew records are removed through the existing engine path
